instruction: I want to increase VLC's maximum volume limit. Please change the maximum volume setting to 200 percent.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
